description: Moves, removes, hides or shows slides of a slide deck, with nothing on them changed. Read the slides' ids with getReportContent. order puts the slides in a new order and names every slide that stays, once each; remove takes slides out of the report; hide keeps a slide in the report but out of what is presented and exported, and show brings it back. Take the change back by restoring versionBeforeId with restoreReportVersion. Called with nothing to change, it answers every slide in order with whether it is hidden: getReportContent leaves hidden slides out. Only the report's editors may.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

hide.description: The slides to hide, by their ids: they stay in the report and are left out when it is presented or exported.

order.description: The report's slides in their new order, by their `id` from `getReportContent`: every slide that stays, once each. Leave it out to keep the order.

remove.description: The slides to remove from the report, by their ids.

show.description: The hidden slides to show again, by their ids.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. Only reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck` work here: another type, such as a Google Slides presentation, returns `400`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/slides/`.

name: arrangeReportSlides
title: Arrange slides
